comment: ANCHOR: NEWS_RISK_RAISE_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1239 weekend/overnight coverage. The lane news-risk-raise tags
every held / stopped-out / watchlist article since the last completed close and raises the material ones into
market_event_candidates (provenance-only, never ranked) and catalyst_events (only when no canonical row exists);
the Home card's two additive blocks read held-name catalysts and the futures/overseas levels from
market_quotes_extended, stating a level-only print as a level and a failed read as a gap. The emulation test
proves the write and the read on a throwaway socket-only Postgres cluster, never the live database.
